'''Hutch''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and joined the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] against the Separatists during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
When the [[King/Legends|King]] of Onderon, [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], allied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Hutch joined the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]],<ref name="AWOTF" /> made up by patriots who refused to recognize the legitimacy of the monarch.<ref name="SWE-dalgo">{{SWE|characters|dalgo|dalgo}}</ref> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Onderon date" /> he was present with [[Dono (Onderonian)/Legends|Dono]] and [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] when [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]] arrived with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], whose goal was to train them to defeat the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. While Rex was training the group to disable an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]], Saw was pushing him on to hurry.<ref name="AWOTF" />

Hutch later fought alongside Dono, Steela, and a group of Rebels on top of a balcony where they ambush a small army of [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] in the [[Iziz/Legends|city of Iziz]].<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref> He would eventually assist the rebels in rescuing [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] from being [[Death|executed]].<ref name="The Soft War">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|battle against the Separatists]], Hutch witnessed [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and his [[Ohnaka Gang]] arrive to the outpost, delivering rocket launchers to the rebels and the [[Onderonian military]] to succeed in winning the battle. He was shot down by a squad of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] that led a small ambush into the outpost.<ref name="TP">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>
